name: Instinctive Healing
body:
You can heal yourself when unconscious.

Prerequisite(s): Con 13, Lay on Hands ability

Benefit: When you are below 0 hit points, but successfully roll to stabilize, your lay on hands ability activates and spends one Lay on Hands attempt on you.

Special: If you have the Diehard feat, this feat is automatically triggered.
